leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a Vue component that defines a reusable button.
Configure the button component to accept props for dynamic text and type.
Implement event handling to emit custom click events from the button.
Apply conditional styling to the button based on its type prop.
Integrate the reusable button component into a parent component.
Manipulate the parent component's state in response to button clicks.
Initialize and bind multiple button instances with different configurations.
